Card Q&A.a: Yes, even if you only reveal one of the applicable cards, you can still add it to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: If the cards I reveal from my deck for this card's [On Play] effect include only either a card with the [Fallen Angel] or [Demon Lord] trait or a purple Option card, can I only add 1 card to my hand?

Card Q&A.a: No. If you have cards that are targets of this effect, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
Card Q&A.q: If the cards I reveal for this card's [On Play] effect include both a card with the [Fallen Angel] or [Demon Lord] trait and a purple Option card, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?

Card Q&A.a: No. Even if you add 2 cards to your hand, you only trash 1 card.
Card Q&A.q: If I add both a card with the [Fallen Angel] or [Demon Lord] trait and a purple Option card to my hand for this card's [On Play] effect, do I trash 2 cards in my hand?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Fallen Angel] or [Demon Lord] trait and 1 purple Option card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. If you added cards, trash 1 card in your hand.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] While your opponent has 6 or fewer cards in their hand, this Digimon gets +1000 DP.
